<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Recipe>
  <Description title="Multi-chamber Cu/W/Si stack" type="Sputtering" author="LAB" notes="Audit fixture for Cluster tool."/>
  <Parameters>
    <Group name="Process Pressures">
      <Param name="PC1" caption="C1 pressure" unit="mTorr" paramType="0">5.00mT</Param>
      <Param name="PC2" caption="C2 pressure" unit="mTorr" paramType="0">2.00mT</Param>
      <Param name="Pbase" caption="Release target" unit="mTorr" paramType="0">0mT</Param>
      <Param name="ArFlow" caption="Ar flow" unit="sccm" paramType="1">40</Param>
    </Group>
  </Parameters>
  <Script>
# --- transfer wafer from LL into C1 ---
home
valve SV_LL open
valve SV_C1 open
transfer LL C1
valve SV_LL close
valve SV_C1 close

# --- C1 setup and deposition ---
valve C1_V open
mfc C1_Ar ArFlow
pwait PC1 600
set C1_PSU1 Frequency 50
set C1_PSU1 DutyCycle 60
set C1_PSU1 Current 250
set C3_PSU1 Current 100
power C1_PSU1 on
message Verify C1 plasma through viewport before opening shutter
deposit C1_Cu 80
deposit Gr 60
power C1_PSU1 off
pwait C1_pm Pbase 10
mfc C1_Ar 0
valve C1_V close
swait C1_pm 0.05mT 120

# --- transfer wafer from C1 into C2 ---
valve SV_C1 open
valve SV_C2 open
transfer C1 C2
valve SV_C1 close
valve SV_C2 close

# --- C2 W deposition (missing valve C2_V open) ---
mfc C2_Ar ArFlow
pwait C2_pm PC2 300
set C2_PSU Frequency 50
set C2_PSU DutyCycle 60
set C2_PSU Current 200
power C2_PSU on
deposit W 60 Home
power C2_PSU off
pwait C2_pm Pbase 10
mfc C2_Ar 0

# legacy cap; deposit W 30

# --- return wafer to LL ---
valve SV_C2 open
valve SV_LL open
transfer C2 LL
valve SV_C2 close
valve SV_LL close
home
  </Script>
</Recipe>

findings.message: Unknown target 'Gr' for 'deposit'. Installed sources: C1_Cu, Ti, W, Si, B4C, C4_Cu
'pwait' takes 3 argument(s) on this machine (sensor target timeout) — the sensor selects which chamber's throttle valve to drive
'set C3_PSU1 Current': unknown parameter 'Current' for C3_PSU1 — the driver would refuse it at run time. Valid (exact spelling): Power
'deposit' takes 2 argument(s), got 3 — 'Home' is not used by this command and would be silently discarded
'message' opens a blocking operator dialog on the Control UI that halts unattended execution and survives abort_recipe
mfc 'C2_Ar' has non-zero flow but none of its inlet gate valves (C2_V) are open

scriptSummary.pwaitTimeoutsNote: pwait/swait timeout arguments (e.g. 600 s, 10 s) are upper-bound ceilings, not fixed durations; total wall-clock run time cannot be determined without running the recipe.
scriptSummary.commentsNote: All text after '#' or '//' on a line (including ';' characters) is stripped before statement splitting and is completely inert.
